concept: Rightsizing: Cost Explorer recommendations + Compute Optimizer
tests: Choosing tools for centralized rightsizing recommendations and finding idle resources across many accounts.
expected: Cost Explorer rightsizing recommendations + AWS Compute Optimizer — utilization analysis, sizing and idle-resource removal recommendations with cost context. Triggers: "right-size underutilized", "idle resources", "many accounts", "least setup".
why_not: Compute Optimizer alone — strong, but lacks cost context (per the question's framing); Budgets only track spend against thresholds; CloudWatch dashboards show metrics without recommendations.
